# Part A: Basic Operations

# A1
```{r}
v <-seq(5, 50, by =5)
length(v)
sum(v)
mean(v)
```

# A2
```{r}
w <-rep(c(1, 2, 3), times =4)
w
z <-rep(c(1, 2, 3), each =4)
z
```

# A3
```{r}
17 %%5
17 /5
2 ^10
sqrt(144)
round(pi, digits =3)
```

# A4
```{r}
a <-c(2, 4, 6, 8)
b <-c(1, 3, 5, 7)
a +b
a *b
a >b
sum(a *b)
```

# A5

paste("Student-1", "Student-2", "Student-3")

# Part B: Data Frames and Conditional Statements

# B1
```{r}
students <-data.frame(id =c(1:8), 
                      name =c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"), 
                      sex =c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
                      section =c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
                      midterm =c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59), 
                      final =c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
                      attendance =c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

# B2
```{r}
students
dim(students)
colnames(students)
summary(students)
```

# B3
```{r}
students$average <-round((students$midterm + students$final)/2, digits =1)
```

# B4
```{r}
students$passed <-students$average >=70 & students$attendance >= 75
```

# B5
```{r}
students$standing <-ifelse(students$average >=90, students$standing <-"Honors", ifelse(students$average >=75 & students$average <90, students$standing <-"Good", students$standing <-"Needs Support"))
```

# B6
```{r}
classify <-function(score){
  if(score >=85){
  return("Distinction")
  } else if (score <=84 &score >=70) {
    return("Merit")
  } else if (score <=69 &score >=50) {
    return("Pass")
  } else if (score <50) {
    return("Fail")
  }
}
sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify)
```
